# Copilot instructions for maestro-manifests

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing. It owns the issue-first workflow,
checks and delivery rules. [CONTEXT.md](../CONTEXT.md) defines the manifest terms;
[README.md](../README.md) describes the catalog and its public/private boundary.

Run `mise exec -- just check`, which runs the content checks and the tests,
before proposing a change. Keep manifest content changes in their own issues.
